# Medical, consumer and court directory additions — 2026-10-09

Scope authorised by the user: medical specialty blocks, defective goods/services/repair, seller/manufacturer defence, October court roster. Existing medical and consumer URLs retained to avoid duplicates. New business page serves a different audience.

## Court source
15 names (chair, deputy, 13 judges) transcribed from user-provided IMG_5201.png, IMG_5202.png, IMG_5204.png, showing krasnodar-oktybrsky.krd.sudrf.ru. Screenshots overlap. No assistants, secretaries or unreadable phone numbers copied. Official live module previously unavailable; public wording explicitly describes screenshot transcription date, not independent live verification.

## Official legal sources checked
- https://zpp.rospotrebnadzor.ru/news/federal/573459 — dentistry, 21 April 2026; used remedies and evidence only, not unqualified sanction promises.
- https://zpp.rospotrebnadzor.ru/news/federal/573688 — salon and medical cosmetic distinction, 30 April 2026; sanitary rules in the source not reused.
- https://zpp.rospotrebnadzor.ru/news/federal/593973 — remedies and deadlines, 29 September 2026.
- https://52.rospotrebnadzor.ru/napravleniya-deyatelnosti/zashchita-prav-potrebiteley/725/ — household service defects and Articles 29–31; search-indexed official text available, direct retrieval of print variant failed.
- https://epp.genproc.gov.ru/ru/proc_57/activity/legal-education/explain/e567579/ — good faith, Articles 1 and 10 Civil Code; full text read. No case-law summary added.
- https://44.rospotrebnadzor.ru/osnovnye_napravlenij/zacshita_prav_potreb/obzor_obracshenij_gr/224/ — quality check, warranty, expert expenses. Older source used only for stable evidence/remedy provisions, not outdated penalty wording.
- https://04.rospotrebnadzor.ru/index.php/otdel-zpp/org/20501-11022026.html — Law 500-FZ effective 1 February 2026: Article 13(7) exceptions and Article 23(1) cap. These are not universal exemptions for every claim/service.

Medical document checklists are practical drafting guidance, not diagnoses or assertions that a bad outcome proves malpractice. No guaranteed sums or results. No client cases published. Consumer-extremism phrase is explained as nontechnical language and never used as automatic evidence of misconduct. Existing styling reused.
